notes: Spring Grove Avenue name is not printed inside the strip (identified by its 100 ft width, car tracks and 48xx-51xx house numbers); Mitchell Avenue name is printed west of the strip near x 3500, y 4250; Kessler's suffix is not printed in the strip, Avenue assumed. Durham Avenue and Railroad Avenue meet as an L corner; Ammen Avenue and Railroad Avenue likewise (at the strip's left margin). Mitchell Avenue's south-west side is cut by the plate edge at Kessler, so that centre is less certain (about 20 px). The Erie Canal strip (lettered ERIE CANAL, 75 ft) crossing Mitchell near 5450,5850 is not a street. No other crossings in the strip: the middle is rail yards, factories and the Mill Creek.
